title: Chapter 1270
text:
In the vast starry sky, the Sanctum's door of light suddenly appeared and spat out Han Xiao. Then, the door of light disappeared without a trace.

Han Xiao was stunned for more than ten seconds. His blurry consciousness seemed to be pulled by gravity, and he suddenly came back to his senses.

"Hmm? I'm already out? "

Han Xiao shivered subconsciously, but the feeling of leaving was the exact opposite of when he entered the Sanctum. It was as if he had passed through a thin film and turned from illusion to reality. His body sank slightly, as if he had entered water from air.

Thinking back to his experience in the Sanctum, his memories became blurry and hazy, as if there was a layer of screen separating him. However, it was much better than Oathkeeper's dream, probably because of his higher authority.

The techniques and knowledge that he had memorized were very clear.

Han Xiao looked down at his palm. The Sanctum Authority mark had disappeared, leaving only the Sanctum Revival mark.

"I wonder how the interface is now. Can I open it now?"

Han Xiao tried to call the interface, and the next moment, a notification popped up.

You have successfully entered the Third Sanctum.

You have received 1 [Third Sanctum] Fragment.

The third round of [Relay Across Iterations] has been completed.

You have received 2,000,000,000 EXP, 2 Random Rewards, and 3 [Third Sanctum] Fragments.

Detected that you have entered the Sanctum. [Third Sanctum] Fragment Synthesis …

Synthesis complete. You have received [Third Sanctum Authority Level 6]!

"As expected, fragments are authority. Although I can't open the interface in the Sanctum, the interface is still running."

Han Xiao's eyes lit up.

He opened the skill introduction of [Third Sanctum Authority Level 6] and took a look. It was basically the same as the introduction on the Sanctum's message board, but the interface was a little more detailed. It also explained that the flow of time in the Sanctum was also related to authority.

Han Xiao took out his communicator, looked at the date, and heaved a sigh of relief.

"Fortunately, it's only been less than four months, which is much shorter than I expected. That unlucky bastard Oathkeeper took several years, so the higher the authority, the closer the time ratio should be to 1: 1."

He felt a lot more relaxed. Originally, he had prepared in years, but now it was less than four months, which was a pleasant surprise.

He turned on his communicator and glanced at it. As he had already informed them before entering the Sanctum, the affairs of the army and the association were operating normally. The past few months had been peaceful, and nothing major had happened. Pangon's group of avengers did not seem to have appeared yet.

"This is the best situation. The initiative is still in my hands."

Han Xiao nodded. He put down the communicator and looked at the interface again. The fourth round of the [Relay Across Generations] mission popped up.

[Fourth round activated!]

Fourth Round Mission Requirements (Optional): 1. Reveal relevant information about the Sanctums, The Great Reboot, and Universe Iterations to the current advanced civilizations (at least at the Supercluster level).

Prove the existence of the Sanctums to the advanced civilizations and help them open the Sanctums.

3. Take advantage of your authority and become the leader of the advanced civilizations into the Sanctums.

Note: You can choose to complete any one or more of the mission requirements. The more missions you complete, the higher the mission rating.

Basic Reward: 2,500,000,000 EXP, 1 Sanctum Fragment

Additional Reward depends on the mission rating.

Han Xiaoxin's heart skipped a beat.

"The fourth round is actually like this? It requires the people who enter the Sanctums to share this precious information with the advanced civilizations … That's right, this is the meaning of a relay. This mission looks at the problem from a higher level. The civilization is the protagonist of the universe's development. The sooner they know about the Sanctums, the more time they have to prepare. The final goal of this mission is to help the civilization get through The Great Reboot as much as possible … "

However, although he understood this, Han Xiao had no intention of doing so.

From the perspective of the mission itself, helping the civilization gain control of the Sanctums as soon as possible was the top priority. However, this would have an unpredictable impact on his plan.

This was no longer a personal matter. Han Xiao had to consider it from the perspective of the entire Beyond Grade A group.

In the future, in order to deal with The Great Reboot, he might have to cooperate with the three Universal Civilizations to develop the Sanctums together. However, as an insider, it was impossible for him to rush to reveal the precious Sanctums to the advanced civilizations. That would be a betrayal to the Beyond Grade As.

Only after the association had a stable grasp of the Sanctums could they cooperate with the three Universal Civilizations. Otherwise, the Beyond Grade A system under the Celestial Star Alliance's rule would be a good example.

"There's no choice in this world …" Han Xiao sighed softly, temporarily extinguishing the thought of completing the mission.

At this time, a few spaceships suddenly removed their disguises and appeared, cautiously asking in the wide area channel.

"Is this Your Excellency Black Star?"

"Yes, it's me."

Han Xiao looked up and was not surprised.

He had already noticed these invisible Holy Covenant spaceships earlier and knew that they were the sentries that Oathkeeper had been waiting for him here.

After a pause, Han Xiao took out his communicator, dialed Oathkeeper's number, and was quickly connected.

Oathkeeper's figure appeared on the screen with a look of surprise.

"Black Star? Didn't you say it would take a few years? Why are you back so soon? "

"Maybe it's because I'm lucky?" Han Xiao shrugged.

"Really? I don't believe it."

Oathkeeper expressed his strong doubts and immediately felt sour.

Why do I have to go for a few years every time I go, but you only go for a few months every time? Is there a difference in treatment? It's not fair!

"By the way, let me ask you, why didn't you tell me about the message board in advance? Little Rascal, are you deliberately hiding it from me?" Han Xiao narrowed his eyes.

If not for the fact that he felt something was wrong, he might have left without seeing the message board. Furthermore, Oathkeeper did not explain the Sanctums' authority beforehand, so he could not help but have doubts about Oathkeeper's intentions.

"What message board? What's that? "Oathkeeper sounded confused.

"You don't know?"

Han Xiao raised his brows and observed Oathkeeper's expression, but he could not see anything.

It was possible that Oathkeeper could not remember because of the authority, or he could be deliberately hiding it. No matter what Oathkeeper's intentions were, this small matter was over, and Han Xiao could not be bothered to pursue it.

"… Forget it, let's get down to business. I've already obtained the Sanctum Revival mark. Quickly bring the fleet over."

"Okay, I'll be right there." Oathkeeper's spirits were lifted, and he immediately agreed.

Han Xiao nodded, thought about it, and added, "By the way, it's best to bring those Primordial Ones. The targets of the revival this time are not acquaintances, so there might be some trouble. We have to suppress them."

"Understood." Oathkeeper nodded.

The targets of the first revival were the old members of the Holy Covenant organization, all of whom were acquaintances of Oathkeeper and had some understanding of the Sanctum Revival, so they were easily appeased. However, this batch of revivals were outsiders, and they basically did not know of the existence of the Holy Covenant. Once they were revived, it would be difficult for them to accept reality.

Just put yourself in their shoes … They had died perfectly fine, and it would be strange if they were not stunned when someone suddenly opened their coffin and revived them.

The targets of the revival this time were all selected, and they were basically all Beyond Grade As who had died an unnatural death. None of them were direct descendants of advanced civilizations, and at most, they were allies. Among them, there were many who had died in the Tragedy of the Pinnacles.

Because the Tragedy of the Pinnacles was the largest collective death of Beyond Grade As in the exploration era, it was very difficult to avoid the victims of the Tragedy of the Pinnacles when looking for suitable revival targets. Han Xiao could not guarantee that there would not be any troublemakers among this group of people.

In his previous life, the Holy Covenant had revived several batches of Beyond Grade As, and there were many outsiders in the organization, but they still took the initiative to appear only during the World Tree War version. They did not leak any information before this, which proved that the Holy Covenant definitely had countermeasures.

The Holy Covenant organization was not a charity organization. Forget about Primordial Ones like Pangon, who had joined early, but if outsiders who revived later wanted to cause trouble, the Holy Covenant would probably not mind putting them back into their coffins and hitting them with a circle of steel nails while they were at it.

This means that Oathkeeper lied to the members of the organization and said that the Sanctum Revival was only limited to one time, which is a good thing. It made the later generations cherish this unique revival and not mess around.

Han Xiao nodded.

After ending the communication, Han Xiao opened the secondary dimensional army box and took out a small mobile base. He rested inside and checked the news of the past four months while waiting for Oathkeeper.

After two days, the fleet of the Holy Covenant organization finally arrived. Together with them were a large number of Primordial Ones.

The fleet sailed into the dock of Han Xiao's mobile base, and the group of people had a friendly meeting at the dock.

"I didn't expect you to come out in just four months. Looks like we don't have to wait another year or two." Beiger and the others were pleasantly surprised.

Han Xiao glanced around but did not see Pangon and the others. He could not help but ask, "Where are Pangon and the others?"

"They already left the Holy Covenant three months ago. There's no news of them now." Oathkeeper shook his head.

Han Xiao nodded and did not say anything. This was something he had already expected. The good news was that he had already returned before Pangon made any big waves.

"Alright, let's not talk too much. Revive this group of people first. You guys stay by the side. Only overwhelming force can make the other party calm down and talk to us calmly." Han Xiao showed the Sanctum Revival brand on the back of his hand.

Everyone nodded without any objections.

The group arrived at the prepared venue and spread out. Han Xiao took the activation device from Oathkeeper, took a deep breath, and pressed the start button.

Hum!

The Sanctum Revival brand suddenly bloomed with thousands of rays of light and left the back of his hand, turning into an expanding, dazzling ball of light.

The next moment, the ball of light split and turned into luminous objects of different shapes. They slowly turned from illusory to solid, turning into awakened Beyond Grade As with confused expressions on their faces.

At the front, an elegant long-eared elf man in a luxurious robe looked around. Finally, his gaze fell on Han Xiao and muttered to himself, "Is this the Netherworld?

"Is this the Netherworld after death … You're dressed like a ghost, so you must be the legendary Pluto."

Han Xiao: "?"

… Speak more if you can, or I'm afraid you won't have a chance in the future.
